title: How to Read a CDD Budget Before You Buy in Estero FL: 2026 Buyer's Guide
excerpt: Find the CDD named on the tax bill, open its adopted budget, and read the per-unit table, the bond maturity date, and the general fund before you offer. At Copper Oaks in Estero, $936 of a $1,352.67 yearly assessment is bond debt that ends May 1, 2035.
